title: remove dead symbols: merge_base, SUBJECT_COMFORTABLE, _PATTERN_FIELD, two unused imports
desc:
AST sweep over lib/ (719 top-level defs) found 6 symbols with zero references anywhere in lib, tests, docs or skills.

DEAD, safe to remove:
- gitctx.py:239 merge_base() -- never called; subjects_since/commits_between pass the base ref straight to git.
- commitmsg.py:16 SUBJECT_COMFORTABLE = 50 -- only SUBJECT_LIMIT (72) is enforced, at :144 and :175.
- flow.py:37 _PATTERN_FIELD -- superseded by validate_pattern at :194, which inlines the same regex.
- cli/flow.py:18 imports WbError, unused.
- cli/pr.py:11 imports json, unused.

NOT dead, tracked separately: anonymise.py:71 _KEYISH is a sibling of _EMAIL/_URL but is never applied in _scrub_embedded, so wb ctx record leaves the tenant's ticket keys verbatim in a committed fixture.

Clean elsewhere: no unreachable statements, no assigned-never-read locals, no orphan modules. One triplicated helper (_root/_repo_root in cli/commit.py, cli/flow.py, cli/git.py).
